# Bash oracle

`actions-snitch.bash` is the unmodified executable from commit `4fbff7e6d120050204a6989752c61dc62d0bed1e`. Its SHA-256 is `45a0586a2d6f3a32e1ac1a572e5984d2df384d4122e326d8d47a937b8b7ec26d`.

The fixture supports differential tests and the original integration suite. It is not installed or called by the production Go executable. Tests provide isolated configuration, caches, repositories, and provider/API stubs.
